_about: USD per 1M tokens, OpenAI standard (non-Batch, non-Flex) list prices, read live on 2026-10-09 from the model pages linked per row.
This is an INPUT you can edit: if your organisation has different pricing, change the numbers; the report prints which file and values were used.
cache_write: GPT-5.6 model pages state 'Cache writes are billed at 1.25x the uncached input token rate'; the value below is 1.25 x input. null = not listed for that model.
Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens (OpenAI reasoning guide) and are already included in usage.completion_tokens.
Prompts over 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input / 1.5x output on GPT-5.6 (model page); the harness flags but does not price that case (Otter prompts are far smaller).

gpt-5.6-sol.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol (pricing page notes Sol promotional pricing at least through 2026-11-21)
